# Pranav Kolluri

::: {.intro}
I'm a first-year Biomedical Engineering PhD student at OHSU, working in Dr. Xubo Song's lab on multimodal single-cell data integration and representation learning.

This site is part of BMI 525: Data Visualization for Biomedical Informatics. Visit the About page for my full background, or Visualization for a flow map of Pacific Northwest flight routes built with R and ggplot2.
:::
